recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀與 FISH 的非型態圖：CD19+/CD10+、CD34−、cTdT−、表面 kappa 輕鏈限制的成熟 B 細胞表型，加上 FISH 顯示 t(8;14) 融合訊號，支持 Burkitt 白血病。
features: Flow cytometry: dominant CD45-positive population that is CD19+ and CD10+ (dual CD10:CD19 quadrant)
CD34-negative with HLA-DR expression; cytoplasmic TdT negative and cytoplasmic CD79a and CD22 positive
Surface kappa light chain restriction with lambda negative on CD19+ cells
Interphase FISH with dual-fusion probe showing yellow fused signals and juxtaposed red-green signals indicating t(8;14)
describe_en: This composite is non-morphologic. Flow cytometric plots show a predominant CD45-positive B-cell population expressing CD19, CD10, cytoplasmic CD79a, cytoplasmic CD22, and HLA-DR, with surface kappa light chain restriction, and lacking CD34, TdT, CD56, and CD117, indicating a clonal mature germinal-center B-cell phenotype. Interphase FISH shows fusion (yellow or juxtaposed red-green) signals, interpreted as positive for t(8;14)(q24;q32) IGH::MYC. The combination of a TdT-negative, CD10-positive, light chain-restricted B-cell population with MYC rearrangement is consistent with Burkitt leukemia/lymphoma in the appropriate morphologic context.

ddx.vs: B-ALL is typically TdT and/or CD34 positive and lacks surface immunoglobulin light chain expression, whereas this population is TdT-negative, CD34-negative, and kappa-restricted.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma can share the CD10+ light chain-restricted phenotype and MYC break, and is separated by BCL2 rearrangement FISH and usually strong BCL2 protein expression.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with more pleomorphism and MYC rearrangement is less common and often non-IG partner, whereas Burkitt shows a near 100% Ki-67 and simple IG::MYC karyotype.
